text:
Alex: Heads-up from CS — three customers hit 502/504s on hosted inference since 23:40 UTC, also a couple of auth timeout errors. They see timeouts in our API and are escalating.
Sam: Which endpoints/models? any commonalities in customer traffic?
Alex: All on /v1/generate and /v1/chat, mixed models but heavy on small-batched short-seq requests. Customers report 10-20s timeouts then a 502.
Maria: I'm seeing a latency spike on the API gateway around 23:38 UTC correlated w/ increased conn queue in apigw-prod-eu-west. p90 went from 120ms to ~3s.
OpsBot: Alert: gateway-concurrency-high apigw-prod-eu-west at 2024-11-06T23:38:21Z (severity: high)
Emily: Oncall here — starting repro against the affected endpoint. Sharing curl and trace.
Emily: curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":20}' 
Emily: Response: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway after ~18s, connection reset. No application traceback in client.
Sam: Can you capture the gateway request id and the backend span id? we need the proxy logs.
Emily: Got request-id: req_0ab12cd3, gw-span: span_gw_77a. Fetching logs: `kubectl logs apigw-prod-eu-west -l pod=apigw-77a -n prod --since=30m | grep req_0ab12cd3`
Maria: Found it — gateway logged upstream connect timeout to runtime-proxy: dial tcp 10.8.6.22:443: i/o timeout.
Raj: That IP belongs to a runtime pool in eu-west dedicated to hosted inference. Any rolling restart or network change?
Alex: CS says customers started right after 23:35 UTC when we pushed a small config tweak to apigw scaling policy (lower minPods). Could be related.
Sam: Check recent deploys: `deploy-bot list --env prod --since '2024-11-06T23:00'`
OpsBot: Deploy-bot: apigw-config-rollout by infra-bot at 2024-11-06T23:34:12Z — strategy: gradual, 3/5 pods updated.
Emily: If apigw reduced available upstream connections during rollout, runtime pool might have hit connection saturation and triggered timeouts. Suggest immediate mitigation: rollback apigw config to previous minPods or pause the rollout.
Raj: Agreed. Also flip on fallback routing to dedicated-overflow pool for short term. I'll open a rollback PR.
Maria: Also seeing elevated tcp retransmits between apigw and runtime in VPC logs — might be packet drops coincident with scaling event.
Sam: Action checklist: 1) Pause apigw rollout (Emily) 2) Rollback config to previous minPods (Raj) 3) Enable overflow routing (Raj) 4) Notify CS + customers with ETA (Alex) 5) Collect full request traces and kv cache stats for impacted timeframe (Maria)
Emily: Paused rollout and cordoned the 2 updated apigw pods. Running `kubectl rollout undo deployment/apigw --to-revision=42` now.
OpsBot: Rollout undo started at 2024-11-06T23:47:05Z (initiated by Emily).
Raj: Enabling overflow route policy: `redwoodctl routes set fallback --pool overflow-eu-west --threshold 0.75` — applied.
Alex: Pinged CS with interim note: "We're mitigating — rollback in progress and fallback routing enabled. We'll update within 20m"
Maria: Gathering traces: exporting spans for reqids between 2024-11-06T23:30 and 23:50. Also pulling runtime-proxy logs and kernel netstat.
Emily: Rollback finished at 23:52, apigw p90 back to ~180ms. Running more repros.
Emily: Repro curl now returns 200 in 350ms for same payload.
Sam: Good. Next steps for postmortem: - Confirm root cause (was it scaling policy + connection storm?) - Add safer rollout checks (circuit breaker warmup) - Add automated surge autoscale for runtime pool - CS communication template and credit offer for impacted customers
Raj: I'll open PRs for a) rollout gating that checks upstream connection health b) increase default minPods for apigw in eu-west.
Maria: I'll attach netstat + pcap snippets and KV cache eviction metrics to the incident doc. Noting we saw 4xx auth timeouts too — likely collateral from upstream timeouts causing retries that exhausted auth service tokens.
Alex: I'll coordinate customer comms and draft a post-incident message for the affected customers.
Emily: For follow-up ops runbook: add a pre-rollout run that simulates 30s sustained traffic and verifies upstream conn pool headroom.
Sam: Assigning action owners: rollback verification (Emily), PRs for gating/minPods (Raj), telemetry artifacts + traces (Maria), CS comms + credits (Alex).
Alex: Will close war room once all artifacts uploaded and PRs linked in the incident doc. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: Incident incident-1768888001 created and linked to incident-tracker #INC-2024-532.
